value.rationale: The theorem gives a sharp finite-sample benchmark for a recurring methodological issue: fold-error dependence invalidates naive standard errors, but in this canonical model it coexists with strictly decreasing true sampling variance as K grows. The exact law also permits exact finite-sample calibration and separates moving-target bias from sampling variability.
